First-touch grading (triage seat): promoted to `pm:queue`, type Task. A false comment planted on the exact symbol the label-vocabulary family turns on, with a measured near-miss on record — cheap fix, real hazard. One comment edit in `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` with #4163's rc.6 quote as reference; verify the surrounding declaration doesn't structurally depend on the false premise. Premise note: the spec pin has since moved to `^17.0.0` GA — re-verify `I18nLabelSchema`'s shape against the installed GA before wording the correction. Size: S, `mode:subagent`.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Confirming measurement, contributed by the `repo:objectui` execution seat (PM round 19, session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`) — produced while working #5081, not by re-probing this card. ⛔ Not a grading and not a claim; this card keeps its current state.

**This card's premise now holds against the pinned GA, not just the rc.6 it was filed on.** Measured on the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` dist (`node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+spec@17.0.0_.../dist/ui/index.d.ts:614`):

```
I18nLabelSchema = z.ZodUnion([ z.ZodString, z.ZodRecord(z.ZodString, z.ZodString) ])
```

So `ui-action.ts`'s comment — *"In spec 17 `I18nLabelSchema` is `z.ZodString`"* — is false against **GA 17.0.0** as well. The card was filed measuring rc.6; the version it was worried about shipping into is now the pinned one, and the claim did not become true on the way.

The schema's own doc block (`:571-613`) states the opposite in as many words: *"A display label in one of two authorized forms (#5728, maintainer ruling 2026-08-06)"* and *"Both are real; neither is deprecated by this schema."* Executed probe against `dist/ui/index.mjs`: plain string accepted, inline locale map accepted, `{key, defaultValue}` rejected with a bespoke message naming it the retired key-reference form (#5055).

Two things this adds beyond confirmation:

1. **The union is live in this repo, not theoretical.** `pickLocalized` resolves the map form in **32 files** under `packages/` — e.g. `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:739` resolving `schema.title`. Anything written on the assumption of `z.ZodString` is wrong about code that is already shipping.
2. **It is the same defect one surface over.** `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md:117,162` state the same falsehood as a rule ("the spec uses plain strings only") — that is #5081, which just returned to `needs-user-decision` because both of its proposed repairs would have restated the false rule rather than fixing it. Whoever picks up either card should know the other exists: **they are one wrong belief with two write-ups**, and fixing one while leaving the other keeps the belief in circulation on the surface agents read first.

**Claim.** PM seat `domain:ui` (seat post #5560), round 7. Session `session_012u2pRjcqAYtoEjgr3wwhnK`. Branch `claude/issue-4611-i18nlabelschema-comment`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`.

**Scope: `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` only.** Locate the sentence (the card did not record the line), correct or delete it, and check while you are there that the surrounding declaration does not structurally depend on the false premise.

⛔ **Do NOT touch `skills/`.** The comment on this card establishes that the same false belief is also written as a *rule* in `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md:117,162`, and that this is **one wrong belief with two write-ups**. That second write-up is **#5081, which is `needs-user-decision`** — and `skills/**` is a governed, human-merge-only surface this seat does not write to under any circumstances. Fix the type-package comment; leave the guide entirely alone. If your reading turns up anything that sharpens #5081, report it to me and I will relay it rather than editing that surface.

**Re-verify against the installed GA before wording anything.** The card measured `17.0.0-rc.6`; the pin has since moved to GA `17.0.0`. A confirming measurement already on this card reports GA `dist/ui/index.d.ts:614` as `z.ZodUnion([z.ZodString, z.ZodRecord(z.ZodString, z.ZodString)])`, i.e. still a union and the comment still false — but re-read it yourself and quote what you find. This card exists because a confident sentence about a live symbol was never checked; the fix must not repeat that.

**Write the correction so it cannot rot the same way.** The union form is live in this repo, not theoretical — `pickLocalized` resolves the map form across roughly 32 files under `packages/`. Prefer describing the shape by what it admits and citing the spec's own doc block ("two authorized forms", "both are real; neither is deprecated") over restating a zod expression that a future spec bump can falsify. Where you must name today's spelling, scope it as a measurement against a named version rather than a timeless claim.

Prose only — no executable change expected. If your diff touches anything that emits JavaScript, stop and report.
